notes.title: New Release - Drakensang: The River of Time
notes.notes:
Drakensang: The River of Time is now available on Steam.

The prequel to Radon Labs' award-winning RPG, Drakensang: The River of Time introduces a brand new story within the Drakensang universe.  Journey down the Great River to the city of Nadoret as you uncover mythical legends.
